title: Local constancy of the coefficient dual
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a commutative noetherian ring, and $F$ a finite locally constant sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant]. Then the internal Hom $\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(F,\Lambda_X)$ is locally constant [def-constructible-locally-constant].

source.place: IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.ihom_unit docstring, local finite presentation and dual finite generation

proof.text: Choose a locally constant datum d for F. Use isConstant_over_iff_upperStar on each member f_i of its etale cover. The pullback has finite stalks by IsFiniteSheaf.upperStar; extract a finite constant model M_i using exists_finite_constant_model.

Use the etale restriction/internal-Hom isomorphism to identify f_i^* Hom(F,Lambda_X) with Hom(f_i^*F,f_i^*Lambda_X). Replace the pulled-back unit using Functor.Monoidal.εIso, then replace f_i^*F by its constant model using MonoidalClosed.internalHom.mapIso.

The constant finite dual isomorphism identifies this sheaf with the constant sheaf Hom_Lambda(M_i,Lambda). Apply Sheaf.isConstant_of_iso, then convert back using isConstant_over_iff_upperStar. The original cover, with these constant restrictions, is a LocallyConstantDatum for the dual.
